recipe.text: Falchion (distinct from prior gladius/dagger/spear/scimitar): Cube mesh from a reference-matched prompt (single-edged blade, clipped angled tip, straight quillons, leather grip, wheel pommel) at 3.5 studs, save_mesh'd durable. Toolified single-part Handle; grip fitted visually over 4 rounds (mesh long axis runs diagonal in its bbox, needed rx=-135 + rz=90). 3-keypose rightArm swing (0.7s) bound as 'use'; previewed from front+right filmstrips - clean over-shoulder-to-hip arc. Fast behavior 0.12/0.15/0.35 with 20 dmg / reach 7 hitbox.
